text.description_html:
Exit Device Pull Plate

This Pull Plate Trim for Global Door Controls ED-501ALARM Alarm Push Bar Exit Device, ED-501-AL Push Bar Exit Device, ED-VR531 Vertical Rod Exit Device, ED-VR531ALARM Alarm Vertical Rod Exit Device and other manufactures Panic Devices. Packaged with mounting hardware.

Used to cover a pre drilled bore hole. This pull plate is used when installing a Panic Device on doors with pre drilled bore holes. where an exterior door pull is desired for entry if the panic device is dogged. Can also be used on Non pre drilled doors.

Also available: Pull Plate with Lock Cylinder

Specifications for Global ED-PP06501-AL Pull Plate

  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Aluminum
  • Pull Plate Height: 7-7/8"
  • Pull Plate Width: 3"
  • Pull Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Mounting Holes: 3/8" Diameter, 4-5/16" Center to Center, 5/16" Offset from Plate Center Line
  • Includes Sex Bolts for Mounting
